property_summary: For any account that successfully initializes C, that account remains the owner and can therefore successfully invoke owner-gated functions (setKeeper) for any fuzzed keeper address, after which keeper() equals the given address; the mutant makes owner() return address(0), so every onlyOwner call reverts and the rule breaks for all inputs.
change_summary: Return address(0) instead of _owner, so owner() always returns the zero address.
